description: Source code for a mod_proxy module in the lighttpd web server, implementing HTTP proxy functionality including connection handling, header forwarding, and backend communication.

classes.name: proxy_context
classes.description: Holds context information for proxy connections, including reference count, backend pool, and socket string.

classes.name: proxy_connection
classes.description: Represents an individual proxy connection, including context, backend connection, and socket buffer.

methods.name: proxy_send_headers
methods.description: Constructs and sends HTTP headers to the backend, forwarding relevant headers from the client request.

methods.name: proxy_backend_free
methods.description: Frees backend pool configuration and clears socket address.

methods.name: proxy_context_new
methods.description: Creates a new proxy context with backend pool based on destination socket string.

methods.name: proxy_context_release
methods.description: Decrements reference count and frees proxy context if no longer used.

methods.name: proxy_context_acquire
methods.description: Increments reference count for proxy context.

methods.name: proxy_io_cb
methods.description: Handles I/O events for proxy connections, manages data transfer and cleanup.

methods.name: proxy_connection_new
methods.description: Establishes a new proxy connection, sets up streams, and sends initial headers.

methods.name: proxy_handle_abort
methods.description: Handles request aborts, stops backend wait if applicable.

methods.name: proxy_handle
methods.description: Main request handler that manages backend connection acquisition and proxy connection setup.

methods.name: proxy_free
methods.description: Frees proxy context when plugin is unloaded.

methods.name: proxy_create
methods.description: Creates a new proxy action based on configuration parameter.

methods.name: plugin_init
methods.description: Initializes plugin options, actions, and setups.
